"Missing or malformed Authorization header"
No 
Authorization

Bearer <token>

.env
 value also causes this.
Send 
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN
. Check 
.env
 is in the folder you run from. Note: expired tokens are documented to return 401.
403
"Forbidden or entropy quota reached"
Either the token is 
wrong
 (live API returns 403, not 401, for a bad token) 
or
 the monthly quota is used up. An HTML "Error 1010" page instead means Cloudflare blocked your client's User-Agent.
Check the token first: no spaces or quotes, correct service (Entropy). Then check quota in the portal. For Error 1010, use 
requests

urllib

429
Too many requests
Rate limit. Docs say 30 requests per 10 seconds, but 
live can return 429 about 1 s after a single prior call
 (seen Oct 14, 2026). The API sends no 
Retry-After
 header.
Wait 10 s or more, then retry once. Never loop; request a larger 
size
 instead of many calls.
500
Internal error
Problem on Qrypt's side.
Try again shortly. If it persists, contact support@qrypt.com.
503
Entropy temporarily insufficient
Qrypt's entropy supply is briefly low.
Try again shortly, with a delay. Don't loop.
